description:
List Change Order Packages.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: ID of the contract to scope change order packages to (a Prime, Purchase Order, or Work Order Contract).

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-...

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: filters[reviewed_at]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) reviewed within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[due_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) due within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[include_deleted]
parameters.description: Use 'only' for only deleted resources. Use 'with' for deleted and undeleted resources.

parameters.name: filters[invoiced_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) invoiced within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[paid_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) paid within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[signed_change_order_received_date]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with a signed change order received date within the specified ISO 8601 date range.

id.description: Unique identifier for this change order package. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve or update it.

contract.description: Contract details including the associated vendor

contract_id.description: ID of the parent contract this change order package belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the change order package was created, in ISO 8601 format.

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who created this change order package.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the change order package was deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null unless the record has been deleted.

due_date.description: Date the change order package is due (YYYY-MM-DD).

executed.description: When true, the change order package has been fully executed (signed by all parties).

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order package was invoiced (YYYY-MM-DD).

number.description: Auto-generated, human-readable number identifying the change order package within its contract.

origin_code.description: Code identifying this record in an external or integrated system.

origin_data.description: Free-form data payload from the external system that created this record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this record in an external or integrated system.

paid_date.description: Date the change order package was paid (YYYY-MM-DD).

reviewed_at.description: Timestamp when the change order package was reviewed, in ISO 8601 format.

signed_change_order_received_date.description: Date the signed change order was received from the vendor (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Status of the change order package. Note: pending_billable is only available in 1-tier change order projects.

title.description: Short title summarizing the change order package.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the change order package was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

revision.description: Revision number for this change order package. This is a manual input field; it is not automatically incremented.

grand_total.description: Total amount of the change order package including markup. Computed from its line items.

designated_reviewer.description: User designated to review this change order package.

id.description: Unique identifier of the designated reviewer user.

login.description: Email/login of the designated reviewer user.

name.description: Full name of the designated reviewer user.

base_currency_iso_code.description: Base Currency ISO Code configured from project level; It'll be populated only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity

401.description: User does not have correct permissions.

403.description: User does not have correct permissions.

404.description: Specified Contract does not exists or User does not have access to it
